title: Problem into solution

editing_notes:
The hook is VERY important, need to nail this.
HOOKS: H1 and H2 use the SAME video and the same spoken line; only the bold header changes (H1: "How to use castor oil on skin tags", H2: "Castor Oil on Skin Tags??"). Opening image for both: extreme close-up of a woman's neck with a skin tag, our roll-on rolling right on it.
Replicate this format exactly: Reference (link above: ORA Organics men's ad, 45 s). Same structure, shots and pacing: the speaker explains one spot, how to apply it, why it penetrates (3D skin layers), then recommends the brand.
WHAT WE CHANGED: the spot is now a SKIN TAG (not the lower belly), and the baking soda is cut completely. Same order, same pacing. ON CAMERA = our money face from the ranking winner #303, Genjutsu from the reference clip where needed. No time frames anywhere (no days, weeks or "overnight") in the script, captions or visuals: it just works and removes them.
THE SKIN TAG SEQUENCE: clip by clip, like #349 0:03-0:08 (https://hyperscale.ceo/briefs/f98d0a85-f2fc-4a0c-9f55-be8dd5e0346a): the same tag getting darker and darker and falling off, each clip on its own script words (see the Visual cell). THE MECHANISM SHOT: Johnny's #189 3D shot at about 0:15-0:17 on "deep down to the root... where it cuts off the skin tag's blood supply": https://hyperscale.ceo/briefs/245a7a3e-8eb5-4a80-b312-83656f40ed78
PROOF: the reference's format; skin tags = our winners #78, #156, #189, #316, #331, #332; the face = #303 (ranking winner, scaling); authority = #243, #319.
PRODUCT: wherever the reference shows the ORA dropper bottle or cotton pack, show OUR amber roll-on (rose quartz ball), built from the real product photos (Products tab). We ROLL it on (never pour or drip from a dropper). No wrap in this one.
ALL PEOPLE ARE WHITE (Caucasian), including extras and 3D characters.
CLARITY: one shot per line, exactly what's said, at the reference's pacing. Timestamps in every Visual cell.
OFFER: 50% off plus a free bottle + 30-day money-back guarantee. No fake deadlines or "selling out".
B-ROLL: him to camera (Genjutsu + #303 face), close-ups of our roller on a skin tag on a woman's neck, the #349-style sequence, Johnny's #189 3D shot.
Captions: small white CAPS lower third, key word highlighted (like the reference).
Landing page: Skin Tags. Doc: Briefs for HS, Brief #25.

Voiceover: His own voice, the same voice as #303. Calm and matter-of-fact, but with REAL CONVICTION on the castor oil part, exactly like #303 when he gets to "A castor oil pack. Nine. And, it's my favorite": he slows down, leans in, and means it. Same pace as the reference (about 45 s). NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: OUR MONEY FACE, the man from our ranking winner #303 (a scaler): the SAME face and voice. Reuse the character from #303's delivered ads in Hyperscale (https://hyperscale.ceo/briefs/264a2c43-67f7-47c7-8896-557bca848c1e): late 30s to 40s, clean-cut, light button-up shirt, at his office desk with the big window behind him (#303's setting). Use Genjutsu with the ORA reference clip as the motion reference where needed (his seated delivery, gestures, holding up the bottle). He never says "Dr." or claims a title (same rule as #303). B-roll skin tag woman: WHITE (Caucasian), 50 to 60, real skin, ONE small realistic skin tag on the side of her neck (the same tag in every close-up).
